sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.637/23 dated : 4/9/2023 registered at P.S. - Ranapura District - Jhabua(M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 376, 450 of IPC.
2. As per prosecution case, it is alleged that the applicant had committed rape with the minor girl by forcibly entering into her house.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the statement of the prosecutrix and her parents have been recorded in the Court and they have turned hostile and have not supported the prosecution case.

As Raju Ajnar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93875333/
1 per the prosecution case itself, the age of the prosecutrix is more than 17 years on the date of incident.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Thus, the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.
4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail on the ground that though the witnesses have turned hostile but age of the prosecutrix is less than 18 years.
5. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the statement of the prosecutrix and her parents in which they have completed turned hostile.
The applicant is in jail since 5/9/2023, the investigation has been completed, the charge-sheet has been filed, I am of the view that the present applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

6. It is directed that applicant Raju Ajnar shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
7. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
8. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.

(VIJAY KUMAR SHUKLA) JUDGE Pramod Raju Ajnar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93875333/
